decisionRef.description: The plan-doc anchor that recorded this disposition. A status without its decision record is not a disposition.

items.description: Verbatim fragment of reproduction that actually shipped. Never plain bedside language — short or generic fragments block legitimate clinical prose.

requireOfficialSourceLink.description: The page must ship the officialSource.formUrl recorded for this instrument. Withdrawing a reproduction leaves a learner needing the real form; a page that says 'not reproduced here' and names no route is a dead end. Requires officialSource on the entry.

officialSource.description: Where the learner gets the real instrument. This library LINKS to the rights-holder's own download and never mirrors a copy: hosting the whole form is broader redistribution than the excerpts that were withdrawn, so a repo-relative path here is a rights change, not an edit (gate check B).

custodian.description: Who publishes the authoritative copy — the party whose terms govern reproduction.

access.description: What the learner actually meets at the link. Say so on the page: sending someone to a paywall or a request form without warning is its own dead end.

formUrl.description: Deep link to the custodian's own form or download page — not a search result. A third-party posting is allowed only where no rights-holder distribution point exists, and then access must be 'institution-protocol' and the note must say whose copy it is.

formLabel.description: What the learner gets, in their words — 'the 11-item form as a PDF', not 'click here'.

trainingUrl.description: The custodian's own training, where it publishes one. Administration teaching is the half a withdrawn reproduction takes with it.

redistribution.description: link-only is the default and the safe one: point at the custodian, never host. 'permitted' requires the permission to be established in the decision record — public-domain release or an explicit grant — and is still no reason to mirror.

verified.description: When this route was last confirmed to resolve. bin/check_instrument_links.py re-checks and reports; a link that rots turns a rights stub back into a dead end.

verifiedVia.description: How it was confirmed, honestly — a live fetch and a search-index sighting are not the same evidence.

allOf._comment: A withdrawal must leave a route. Retiring or restricting an instrument removes the only copy a learner had; without officialSource the page can only say what it no longer shows, which is where the 2026-08-20 audit's removals left three surfaces.
A page pin cannot demand a link the entry never recorded.
